On TCL Google TV, the remote\'s Settings (gear), Netflix and YouTube buttons don\'t work with the new home screen. To get them back, choose Use the TV\'s own home screen.

On Google TV, the remote\'s Settings (gear) button opens Google TV\'s own settings panel, which on many TVs also has the picture and sound settings for the input you\'re watching. With the new home screen it may stop working. To get it back, choose Use the TV\'s own home screen.

{tv} keeps its own home screen. The dock and the look belong to the new home screen, and it isn\'t on this TV.
{brand} only allows its own home screen, so Setup didn\'t add ours. The clean-up works without it.
The new home screen needs Android 8 or newer, so Setup didn\'t add it. The clean-up works without it.
We don\'t know this TV\'s own home screen well enough to switch it safely, so Setup left it alone.

This TV\'s Wi-Fi was saved by its setup wizard. The new home screen needs the wizard off, which would forget the Wi-Fi, and with the wizard left on the TV can crash. So Setup left the home screen alone.

This TV\'s Wi-Fi was saved by its setup wizard, and we don\'t know this TV well enough yet to switch the wizard off safely. With the wizard left on, a new home screen can crash the TV, so Setup left it alone.
We couldn\'t check who saved this TV\'s Wi-Fi. The new home screen needs the setup wizard off, which could forget the Wi-Fi, so Setup left the home screen alone.
On this Google device the new home screen needs the setup wizard off, and then casting from phones stops working after every restart. So Setup left the home screen alone.
On this TV family the setup wizard comes back at every restart, and with the TV\'s own home screen off the TV can fail to start. So Setup left the home screen alone.
On this TV the remote\'s app buttons only work through its own home screen, so Setup left the home screen alone.
We don\'t know this TV well enough to switch its setup wizard off, and with the wizard left on and the TV\'s own home screen off, the TV can crash. So Setup left the home screen alone.

Home goes to a home screen app you installed, and the TV\'s own home screen isn\'t one this app can find on the TV, so Setup left the home screen as it is and didn\'t add ours. The clean-up works without it.

Home goes to a home screen app you installed, and the TV\'s own home screen is switched off, not by this app. So Setup left the home screen as it is and didn\'t add ours. The clean-up works without it.

This TV already has the Clean Your TV home screen, put on another way (for example with the computer tool), under another key. Setup left it as it is and didn\'t add its own copy. The clean-up works without it.
Setup left the home screen alone when it last ran, but this app has changed since and may now add the new home screen.
Another home screen app is set up on this TV, so Setup left the home screen alone.
To use the new one, remove that app, then run Setup again. Or tell us with Report a problem.
On this TV a system service also answers the Home button. One TV like that failed to start after its home screen was switched, so Setup left the home screen alone.
PatchWall is on while Mi TV+ or its web content is off. One TV like that failed to start after its home screen was switched, so Setup left the home screen alone.
To use the new one, run Setup again and switch PatchWall off in Customise.
The new home screen isn\'t installed on this TV right now.
To change this, forget every Wi-Fi network saved on the TV, then join yours again. A cable alone doesn\'t change it. Then run Setup again.
Running Setup again checks once more.

Please keep your launcher installed: without it the TV may have no home screen to go to. If you\'d like the new home screen, tell us with Report a problem and we\'ll work out the safe way for this TV with you.

If you\'d like the new home screen, turn the TV\'s own home screen back on first. On the TV: Settings, Apps, See all apps, Show system apps, then {app}, and Enable (the names differ a little between TVs). Keep your launcher installed. Then run Setup again, and it checks once more.

To have this app look after it (the dock, the look and updates), first undo it with the restore of the tool that put it on, which brings the TV\'s own home screen back, then run Setup again. Please don\'t uninstall it before that: the TV may have no other home screen to go to.
